findings.topic: Paracelsus's arsenic and mercury iatrochemistry
findings.doc_claim: Vol I:161, the arsenic and mercury line. Necrocursica:121 calls him "the finest Iatrochemist I have personally known". Vol I:68 has him separating compounds into "Sulphur, Salt, and Mercury".
findings.canon: There is no medicinal-metal doctrine anywhere (see ae-07), and arsenic appears nowhere in canon outside the Codex. Canon names raw minerals plainly ('antimony', Alchemetrica:294; 'saltpetre and vitriol', :214) and gives made solvents trade names (Strongwater, Kingswater, Blackstone Oil, Salt-spirit, Ghostsalt, :212-218). Crucible palsy is a tremor with 'irritability, then shyness', the pattern of mercury poisoning (:248). Draft-mark stains the sclera and nailbeds (:249). A pure alchemist's catalyst network is 'grown out of exposure, which is another word for poisoning' (:72). Cael Dareth's card has 'hands burned pale by mercury' (wiki/Volume I — Character Cards/Cael Dareth · The Pale Crucible.md:24). The Heresiology addresses 'licensed spagyrists' (The Heresiology of Alchemy.md:14). The real history is not canon: Paracelsus used mercury and arsenic compounds medicinally and held that the dose decides the poison.
findings.why_it_matters: The line is Paracelsus's defining trait. Canon's body-cost table already describes what long mercury handling does, so the claim can be made concrete rather than left as flavour.
findings.question: How should the converted Codex present Paracelsus's use of arsenic and mercury?

options.label: Keep the real names and make the dose the point
options.consequence: The medicine works at a dose and poisons past it, and Paracelsus carries the cost as early crucible palsy and Draft-mark. This ties him to Alchemetrica's cost table and gives Kwon something to observe.

options.label: Replace them with in-world trade or cover-names
options.consequence: Fits Alchemetrica's cover-name tradition and the solvent names. Loses the historical nod and the plain-mineral register canon uses for raw stock.

options.label: Cut the iatrochemistry line
options.consequence: Loses a trait that defines the character, and the Necrocursica's 'Iatrochemist' needs rewording.

findings.recommendation: Keep the real names. Canon names raw minerals plainly and already has the mercury-palsy symptoms written. Check the dose and mechanism through research before printing.
findings.verify_evidence: wiki/The Alftian Codex/Volume the First.md:68,161; Necrocursica:121; grep 'arsenic' over wiki/ and rules/ finds nothing outside the Alftian pages; Alchemetrica.md:72,212-218,248,249,294; wiki/Volume I — Character Cards/Cael Dareth · The Pale Crucible.md:24; Heresiology.md:14

findings.topic: The Necrocursica's 'Accord Level III/IV/V clearance' against canon's vocabulary
findings.doc_claim: Necrocursica:161 has "Category One ... Authorized at Accord Level III clearance" and :173 "Level V clearance with individual review". Corrant Papers:5 reads "Level IV Clearance Required".
findings.canon: 'Level' is the character Level, 1 to 500 below Stage XV (wiki/Fracture of Worlds — The Living System/I. Levels, Experience and Stat Points (Parts One–Three).md:16-17). Canon writes clearance as a Tier: Lyssara Veyn, 'Senior Necrosophist, Mortalis Branch', holds 'Clearance Tier II Restricted (Post-Temperance Corpus Studies)' (wiki/Volume I — Character Cards/Lyssara Veyn · The Black Chrysalis.md:24, :31), and Deimos holds 'Tier II Provisional' (Deimos · The Sin Eater.md:35). For formulas, the Bench's device is reservation: 'forbidden to any practitioner below a stated Tier' (wiki/Factions, Bloodlines & Institutions/The Bench of Attribution.md:86), written as 'reserved T5' (The Standing Index.md:127, :129). R14-5 requires system terms to be used exactly.
findings.why_it_matters: 'Level III' reads as a character level, which a terminology check fails. A literal renumbering to 'Tier III' clearance would also bar canon's own senior Mortalis scholar, who holds only Tier II, from Category One.
findings.question: How should the Necrocursica's authorisation grades be written?

options.label: Bench reservation for operations
options.consequence: Category One is reserved T3, Two reserved T4, Three reserved T5 with individual review. The operations sit on the Standing Index scale, and Lyssara (Tier of Standing 6) qualifies.

options.label: Archive clearance, 'Tier III/IV/V Restricted'
options.consequence: Matches the card wording, but Lyssara's Tier II Restricted then bars her from Category One unless her card or the numbers change.

options.label: Keep 'Level'
options.consequence: Collides with character Level and fails R14-5.

findings.recommendation: Use Bench reservation for the operations. Keep Lyssara-style archive clearance ('Tier IV Restricted') only where a document's access is meant, as in the Corrant Papers header and cross-references.
findings.verify_evidence: Necrocursica:161,169,173; Corrant Papers:5; I. Levels...:16; Lyssara Veyn card :24,:31 ('Tier II Restricted'), :42/:57 (Tier of Standing 6, estimate); Deimos · The Sin Eater.md:35; Bench of Attribution.md:86; Standing Index.md:127,129; rules/pack-14-fourteen.yaml:204

findings.topic: No Mortalis operation table in canon (Categories One to Four)
findings.doc_claim: Necrocursica:161-181 sets out Category One (reading), Two (stabilisation, :169), Three (Volitional Trace completion, :173) and Four ("not authorized", :181).
findings.canon: The Alchemical Index has two Mortalis formulas, Stillgate Ash T3 and Gravetide Ink T4, and no Dissolution formula (Codex Alchemical Index #16, #27). Spell Index precedents with a Temperance Min ($WOTR_TRUE_CANON/The Master Codex.xlsx, Spell Index): Prismatic Recall, Murmuring+ (row 42); Equilibrium Archive, Flourishing+ (32); Sediment Reading, Glory+ (95); Obol Passage, Oblation/Mortalis, Flourishing+ (86); Soul-Drift Passage, Glory+ (98); The Still Gate's Mercy, Mortalis/Somnalis, Transcendence+ (10), which lets 'a dying soul pass without becoming a wandering Echo'; The Silver Archive Opened, Anamnesis, Invocation+ (9). Canon already has an Anamnesis Draft class: Codex AlchType 'Memory Catalyst' (Lists), the Anamnesis Draught (T6) and Mnemonis Solution (wiki/Artifacts/Mnemonis Solution · The Recursive Draft.md:29). Nothing in canon covers Volitional Trace completion or building an impression-body. Heresiology:170 gives the Mortalis doctrine only.
findings.why_it_matters: Category Three is the plot engine of all five texts and has no Tier, Stage floor or cost anywhere in canon. Under R18-2, a new Alchemical Type is not needed for memory Drafts; a Mortalis operation table is what is missing.
findings.question: Does canon need a Mortalis operation table before the conversion, and in what form?

options.label: No table; map in author notes
options.consequence: The Necrocursica stays the in-world source of the four Categories, and each is noted against an existing Tier and a Spell Index precedent. Fastest. Category Three stays uncosted.

options.label: Spell Index rows for Categories One to Three
options.consequence: Each gets a Temperance Min, Wellspring and glyphs through the R18-2 check. For example: One at Flourishing+ (Equilibrium Archive precedent), Two at Glory+, Three at Refraction+ (Gillus is Stage VII). The texts gain citable floors.

options.label: Alchemical Index rows for the Mortalis materials
options.consequence: Puts the trade into the economy, for example a Trace-reading incense and a Category Three substrate, and raises Class IV provenance questions (see ae-11).

findings.recommendation: Spell Index rows for the operations, which should be proposals for Isaac rather than drafted canon. The Stage floors above are suggestions for him to set. Add an Alchemical Index row only for the Category Three substrate, if ae-11 goes that way.
findings.verify_evidence: Codex Spell Index rows (header = row 1): 9 Silver Archive Opened Invocation+ Anamnesis; 10 Still Gate's Mercy Transcendence+ Mortalis/Somnalis ('letting a dying soul pass without becoming a wandering Echo'); 32 Equilibrium Archive Flourishing+; 42 Prismatic Recall Murmuring+; 86 Obol Passage Flourishing+ Oblation/Mortalis; 95 Sediment Reading Glory+; 98 Soul-Drift Passage Glory+; Lists AlchType 'Memory Catalyst'; wiki/Artifacts/Mnemonis Solution · The Recursive Draft.md:29; Heresiology.md:170; Vol III:50 (Stage VII Mortalis/Anamnesis practitioner)

findings.topic: The impression-body and the Mortalis commission on the ladders
findings.doc_claim: Necrocursica:173 says to "create a material substrate capable of holding the impression", and :177 has a Mortalis seal that makes it temporary. Vol III:276: "the impression-body would have eleven days of sufficient coherence."
findings.canon: The Summons ladder places a called thing by call cost times η (X. The Tier Ladders:310). It records provenance as Donated, Analog, Native or Anchored, where Anchored means 'Crystal function borrowed from a vein, a bloodline or a Domain' (:346-350). A sustain is a clock, and a non-Essence cost is recorded beside the rung (:343). Ardency Density governs a construct's weight and duration (IV. The Eight Primaries and the Sixty-Four Sub-Stats:44). Canon's categories include Animatria, an identity-layer construct or 'fielded Echo' (wiki/Artifacts/The Latch of Twinned Souls · Soulbound Echo Focus.md:31), and Mnemata. Class IV Carry is 'identity-shaped' (The Standing Index.md:29). Sovereign-carry means 'the working is the source, wearing a formula' (:49). The one clean lawful source is a consented render (:54). Heresiology:170: 'The dead may leave traces. The trace is not the soul.' Canon is silent on the impression-body's cost, Class and substrate. The wife died two years before the commission (Vol II:27), so by the Necrocursica's own timing her Aetheric Shell was long gone (Necrocursica:101).
findings.why_it_matters: The commission is the central event of all five texts. Without a ladder placement it cannot carry the cost and counterplay the conversion is meant to add.
findings.question: What is an impression-body in the economy: a summon, a Draft product, or both?

options.label: A summon (Animatria) on the Summons ladder
options.consequence: Placed by call cost with Anchored provenance, borrowed from the Trace and Bond. The eleven days are its sustain clock and the Mortalis seal its end condition. It needs a call-cost figure.

options.label: A Draft product
options.consequence: The substrate is an unentered alchemical work with Class, Fidelity and Carry, Class IV if the dead are rendered. This puts it in the Bench economy and raises Class IV lawful-source questions.

options.label: Both: an alchemical substrate animated by an Animatria call
options.consequence: Most faithful to the Necrocursica's own split between substrate and sealing chain, and to canon's split between the Drafts and Summons ladders. Two figures to set.

findings.recommendation: Both. Carry explains why the body 'knew the names', because Class IV Carry is identity-shaped. Madeleine's design of her own commission reads naturally as a consented render, the only clean Class IV source, and the Aphorism ('He summons himself, arranged in their image') becomes a statement about Carry.
findings.correction: The citations and the three options stand, and 'Both' is a reasonable recommendation. The Carry and consented-render argument over-reaches. Class IV is 'Rendered from something that carried a Soul Crystal' (Standing Index:29). A consented render is a practitioner who 'willed the body to a house, executed after death under witness' (:54). Nothing in the texts says Madeleine Ault was a Crystal-bearer: she died of lung-sickness (Vol II:27). And an impression-body built from Traces renders no body, so Class IV applies only if Isaac decides the substrate contains rendered remains. Present that as a sub-question, not as a natural reading. Supporting canon the auditor did not use: the Disciplines table defines Animatria as constructs 'fabricated from the practitioner's own Essence Core' (wiki/Information not on WIKI/The Disciplines.md:56). That supports the Animatria option and the Aphorism directly, but its folder makes its canon status uncertain. Heresiology:210 (case III) already describes the result: 'She spoke, knew names'.
findings.verify_evidence: X. The Tier Ladders:310,343,346-350; IV:44; The Latch of Twinned Souls:31; Standing Index.md:29,49,54; Heresiology.md:170,210; Vol II:27; Vol III:276; Necrocursica:101,173,177,465; Corrant Papers:131

findings.topic: Spagyria and the Tria Prima against Alchemetrica's operations
findings.doc_claim: Vol I:68: Spagyria separates compounds into "Sulphur, Salt, and Mercury ... Separate. Purify. Recombine." Necrocursica:169 makes it the basis of Category Two stabilisation, and :121-137 maps the Tria Prima onto Trace, Residue and Echo.
findings.canon: The Heresiology addresses 'licensed spagyrists' (The Heresiology of Alchemy.md:14) and teaches a Sevenfold Great Work (:23), which matches Vol II:149's seven stages. Alchemetrica's doctrine is 'reagents are the nouns, the Wellspring is the verb, Glyphica is the grammar' (:15). It has Four Operations: Distillation separates, and Conjunction merges and is 'the most dangerous operation' (:98-104). It has Twelve Turnings, including the Parting and the Wedding (:110-123). Drafters are kept off Conjunction benches for four more years (:314). Houses write in their own cover-grammars (:291-295). The Tria Prima appears nowhere in canon outside the Codex.
findings.why_it_matters: It decides where Paracelsus's signature method sits in rank and danger, and whether a new doctrine enters canon.
findings.question: Should the Tria Prima stay as Paracelsus's personal grammar, become canon doctrine, or go?

options.label: His house grammar, glossed in Alchemetrica's terms
options.consequence: No canon change. Spagyria reads as a Parting (Distillation) followed by a Wedding (Conjunction), so it is Master-of-the-Circle work at T4 or above, which explains its danger and his standing.

options.label: Promote the Tria Prima into Alchemetrica as doctrine
options.consequence: New doctrine that needs the R18-2 check and ratification. Every later alchemist inherits it.

options.label: Drop it and keep only the Four Operations
options.consequence: Loses the structure of the Necrocursica's Chapter the First.

findings.recommendation: Keep it as his house grammar. Canon already expects house cover-grammars and licensed spagyrists, and the Conjunction step gives Category Two a canon danger and rank for free.
findings.correction: There is an error in option 1's gloss. The Parting is the Separation Turning (Alchemetrica:115, :128), not Distillation. Canon's closest match to 'Separate. Purify.' is the Distillation Wellspring and operation, 'Separates and purifies into isolated truth' (Alchemetrica:29) and :102. 'Recombine' is Conjunction, done at the workshop level as the Wedding (:117, :134), where 'a Rupture happens'. 'Master-of-the-Circle work at T4 or above' is an inference. Alchemetrica:314 only says Drafters are kept off Conjunction benches for four more years, and no page ties a workshop rung to a Standing Index Tier. Present the rank as a suggestion. The rest (Heresiology:14 and :23, the Sevenfold stages at Heresiology:44 matching Vol II:149, the cover-grammars at :291-295, Tria Prima absent outside the Codex pages) is confirmed.
findings.verify_evidence: Alchemetrica.md:15,26-33,98-104,110-123,128,134,291-295,314; Heresiology.md:14,23,44; Vol II:149; Vol I:68; Necrocursica:121,169; grep 'tria prima' finds only wiki/The Alftian Codex/Volume the First.md and wiki/Lore & History/The Alftian Codex.md

findings.topic: Anamnesis Wellspring activation at regional scale (Genesio, the Tempus drift)
findings.doc_claim: Corrant Papers:211 calls the Wellspring "a storage system for the Aetheric record of every significant experience". :261 says it is "behaving as a queue". Vol III:142 describes an "upward resonance cascade" that shifts Tempus.
findings.canon: The Heresiology lists Anamnesis corruption as 'regional saturation through repeated retrieval' (The Heresiology of Alchemy.md:171) and records 'The Drift of Tempus' as a case (:212). The sites ladder: a vein feeds a site (X. The Tier Ladders:443), a site under Obsession Force 'stands one rung higher' (:480), and a drawn site falls (:482). Some sites are recorded but 'Not placed' (:500). Anamnesis fails by 'Thermal resetting', erasing a record in the act of taking it (Limina — Entropy, Void and Mind.md:66). The Silver Archive Opened (Invocation+) reads Maelor's Echo Vaults. The Codex meta page calls Correspondence 'a law of response' (wiki/Lore & History/The Alftian Codex.md:71). Canon is silent on Tempus mechanics and on what energy could move a celestial body.
findings.why_it_matters: Pricing the Tempus drift literally as energy would demand world-scale output from Stage VII scholars and break the Stage bands.
findings.question: How should the Genesio activation sit on the economy?

options.label: Read it on the sites ladder; Tempus as correspondence
options.consequence: The Genesio node gets a rung, one higher while Thom draws under Obsession Force, and each activation is a Draw. The Tempus drift is the Above answering, not an energy transfer. Uses canon ladders and invents no joule figure.

options.label: Price the drift in joules on the spine
options.consequence: Forces World-scar-scale energy out of Stage VII practitioners and breaks the Stage bands.

options.label: Leave it unplaced
options.consequence: Honest, like X:500's 'Not placed' list, but gives no counterplay.

findings.recommendation: Read it on the sites ladder and treat the drift as correspondence. It uses the ladder canon built for exactly this, and the Codex's own correction ('a law of response') already rejects a mirror-energy reading.
findings.correction: The auditor cited Heresiology:171 and :212 but missed :211. Case IV, 'The Genesio Activation Sequence', places the Genesio activation doctrinally: 'accumulating distortions in Wellspring pressure and celestial correspondence', with the instruction 'Fermentation Perverted often arrives crowned with achievements'. The pathology table gives Catastrophic Germination (Fermentation) the scale 'Regional corruption' (:273). So canon is not silent on how Genesio is classed. It is silent only on its energy, rung and cost. The recommendation should keep the sites-ladder reading and add that the activation must stay consistent with Fermentation Perverted and with 'celestial correspondence', which also supports reading the Tempus drift as correspondence.
findings.verify_evidence: Heresiology of Alchemy.md:171,211,212,273; X. The Tier Ladders:443,480,482,500; Limina — Entropy, Void and Mind.md:66; Codex Spell Index row 9; wiki/Lore & History/The Alftian Codex.md:71; Vol III:142; Corrant Papers:211,261

findings.topic: 'Commission': a private job against canon's Accord Commission
findings.doc_claim: Vol II:23: "Paracelsus has taken the commission." Corrant Papers:125: "commissioning a practitioner is not itself a clear violation".
findings.canon: In canon, a Commission is an Accord instrument with a Danger Tier from T1 to T9 and a Sigil (X. The Tier Ladders:56-69), and 'A Commission Tier is not a Grade' (:71). An unentered formula is 'lawful to hold and unlawful to sell' (Alchemetrica:302) and sits 'outside every instrument the economy uses' (The Bench of Attribution.md:49). The Heresiology already uses the private sense: 'The Eastern Commission of Grief' (:210) and 'grief-powered commissions' (:170).
findings.why_it_matters: Read as an Accord Commission, the grief job would be Accord-sanctioned. Read as a private job, it is an unentered working done for a patron, which gives Corrant an enforcement hook.
findings.question: What kind of transaction was Paracelsus's commission?

options.label: A private commission for an unentered working
options.consequence: Lawful to hold and grey to perform for a patron. It keeps the Heresiology's case title and Corrant's 'not itself a clear violation'.

options.label: An Accord Commission with a Danger Tier and Sigil
options.consequence: The Accord sanctioned it, which contradicts the Codex's secrecy and the Mortalis doctrine.

options.label: Rename it 'engagement'
options.consequence: Avoids the collision and breaks the link to the Heresiology's case title.

findings.recommendation: A private commission, lower-case and in the Heresiology's existing private sense. Say in the text that the working was never entered with the Bench.
findings.correction: The citations check out, but option 1's consequence understates the law. Alchemetrica:302 says unentered formulas are 'lawful to hold and unlawful to sell'. A paid private commission for an unentered working is therefore not merely grey. It sits in tension with Corrant:125 ('commissioning a practitioner is not itself a clear violation'). If the recommended wording ('never entered with the Bench') is adopted, then either Corrant's line is read as being about the patron and not the practitioner, or the conversion must say whether money changed hands. Add that choice to the question.
findings.verify_evidence: X. The Tier Ladders:56-69,71; Alchemetrica.md:302; Bench of Attribution.md:49; Heresiology.md:170,210; Vol II:23; Corrant Papers:125

findings.topic: Residue categories: three against four, and canon's glossary noun Residue
findings.doc_claim: Vol II:99 gives three residues: "the Harmonic Imprint ... the Sympathetic Bond Trace ... and the Parunic Echo". Necrocursica:95-111 gives four 'canonical' ones: Corporeal Residue, Aetheric Shell, Nospheric Echo, Volitional Trace. Category One reads "Aetheric Shell, Nospheric Echo, and Volitional Trace" (:161).
findings.canon: The meta page follows Vol II's three plus the Trace (wiki/Lore & History/The Alftian Codex.md:58-59). 'Nospheric intrusion' is live Sub-Stat vocabulary (IV. The Eight Primaries and the Sixty-Four Sub-Stats:91). Residue is a canon noun (R13-6, rules/pack-13-thirteen.yaml:407) and a standard technique field: 'a renderer reads better off the dead' (wiki/Techniques/Oneiron Parasite · Nightmare Warden.md:68). R57-21 makes Ambient Resonance 'a facet of Residue'. Class IV rendering buys from the dead (The Standing Index.md:54-59).
findings.why_it_matters: What Category One reads, and so where it sits on the ladders and who buys the Corporeal Residue, depends on which list governs. A Mortalis or residue seam may also raise this; it is logged here because the economic placement depends on it.
findings.question: Which residue list does the conversion carry, and how does it attach to canon's Residue?

options.label: The Necrocursica's four, with Vol II's three folded in as facets of Residue
options.consequence: The Harmonic Imprint is read as the Nospheric Echo. The Sympathetic Bond Trace stays as a relational thread. The Parunic Echo is a working's Residue. The meta page needs rewording, and it follows the R57-21 precedent.

options.label: Carry all seven
options.consequence: Nothing is lost, and readers get two overlapping taxonomies.

options.label: Vol II's three plus the Trace
options.consequence: Drops the Corporeal Residue and the Aetheric Shell, and with them the Accord's forensic tool and the link to the Class IV render trade.

findings.recommendation: The Necrocursica's four as facets of Residue. The Corporeal Residue then ties the Mortalis texts straight into the Class IV rendering economy. Present the Stage-scaled retention (Necrocursica:97) as an in-world observation, not as a new rule for pricing stock.
findings.verify_evidence: Vol II (docx):99; Necrocursica:97,101,105,109,161; wiki/Lore & History/The Alftian Codex.md:58-59 (it attributes the three to 'the Necrocursica', which the Necrocursica itself contradicts); IV:91; rules/pack-13-thirteen.yaml:423 (Residue in the vocabulary list; :407 is the rule id); rules/doc-backfill-rulings-2026-09-26.yaml:471-479 (R57-21); Oneiron Parasite · Nightmare Warden.md:68; Standing Index.md:54-59

missed.topic: The Heresiology's Historical Cases already hold the five texts' events as canon case law
missed.detail: Cases II to V are the Codex story told as doctrine. II is 'The Compelled Author and the Necromantic Manuscript' (the Necrocursica), III is the Eastern Commission of Grief, IV is the Genesio Activation Sequence and V is the Drift of Tempus. The conversion has to agree with them. Case II describes the manuscript's author as a talented writer 'pulled by access and manipulated through need', whose 'warning survived as a footnote'. That fits Noxinus and may not fit Malphas as the new author. The auditor used only the case titles and never treated them as constraints.
missed.evidence: wiki/Materials, Alchemy & Trade/The Heresiology of Alchemy.md:209-212, :273
missed.question: Case II describes the Necrocursica's author as a coerced writer. With Malphas as the new author, does he fit that description, or is case II reworded to match him? Option A: write Malphas as pulled in and manipulated, so the case stands. Option B: reword case II to fit Malphas's real motive, which is a canon edit. Option C: case II refers to a different, earlier manuscript. Recommendation: A if Malphas's card allows it, because it needs no canon change.

missed.topic: Category One is already a canon Distillation working
missed.detail: This is mechanical. Necrocursica Category One uses 'Distillation-aligned glyph chains' with Ie, Ur and Flx. Those are exactly Alchemetrica's glyphs for Distillation, which Alchemetrica calls 'the forensic operation'. R18-5-ALCHEMY_DOCTRINE_BINDING binds any working that touches Distillation or Dissolution to Alchemetrica's entries. So Category One places cleanly as a Distillation working. The binding also puts Category Three's Dissolution-adjacent steps under Alchemetrica's Preparation Failure rule: 'Transmutatio, Dissolution and Calcination are volatile and do not deactivate at all'. That gives a ready failure mode for a mishandled Category Three.
missed.evidence: Necrocursica:161,165; Alchemetrica.md:27,29,102,266; rules/pack-18-eighteen.yaml:262-280 (R18-5-ALCHEMY_DOCTRINE_BINDING, live)

missed.topic: Canon's making cost and item cap for workings, missing from ae-03 and ae-05
missed.detail: X. The Tier Ladders charges a maker a share of their reserve for standing workings: a tenth for a blade, a quarter for proofed armour, a hundredth for a round. It caps an item's Tier at the lower of its material's tier and the maker's Tier of Standing. The first rule is the only canon precedent for what bench work costs the maker, and it bears on ae-03. The second is the real product cap, and under it a Class Ø pure alchemist (Dormant, pre-Initiate) has no Tier to stand on, which bears on ae-05.
